store_info.description_short: Privacy-first, self-hosted web analytics: track visitor traffic, events and conversions without cookies or third-party data sharing.
description_long: Umami is an open-source, privacy-first alternative to Google Analytics. It tracks page views, events, traffic sources and conversions without cookies, without selling visitor data, and without needing a cookie-consent banner in most jurisdictions.

Everything stays on your own shard: Umami stores its data in a PostgreSQL database running alongside it, and nothing is sent to a third party except optional anonymous telemetry, which is disabled by default on Freeshard.
store_info.hint: Umami's own login is disabled; access is controlled by your shard's pairing, same as every other private app.
